Jerónimo reported a fall at home on Sep 25, 2026 in the bedroom getting out of bed. His grandson Robert found him on the floor. Denies head strike or loss of consciousness. Small skin tear to left forearm, cleaned and dressed. Vitals stable. Fall risk reassessed as high. PT referral placed for gait evaluation.

PT evaluation following fall on Sep 25, 2026. Gait slow and unsteady with intermittent cane use; Timed Up and Go 19 seconds. Recommend front-wheeled walker, home safety evaluation, and grab bars in the bathroom. Will see twice weekly for strength and balance.
Assisted with light housekeeping and meal prep. Jerónimo in good spirits.
